ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering >95% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters providing high macro-contrast at specific points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black mass spanning both lobes; discrete high-contrast white clusters mapped to the distal lateral tips and trailing edges, with thin linear white pixel paths scattered across the central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a deep, sharp vertex; bounding-box depth occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low-amplitude pixel variations along the entire trailing boundary; presence of multiple small-scale indentations creating a jagged perimeter.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the far-left tip and the upper-right margin, indicative of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multidirectional, fine-width white linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across the dark field of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense distribution of parallel linear rake marks across the fluke surface and multiple barnacle-related scars on the lobe margins.
